title: Robot Boy
concept: A solitary figure navigates a series of shifting architectural realities, transitioning from static observation to frantic movement through layered textures.
style: A recurring figure appears throughout: A young adult wearing a heavy oversized linen jumpsuit in a neutral grey tone..

scenes.lead: Cyanotype sun print on rough cotton rag paper:
scenes.style: Deep Prussian blue and raw paper white only, brush-stroked emulsion edges, fibrous paper grain visible throughout, high contrast with no midtones, hand-coated unevenness. No photorealism — the material and process are the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: A vast, empty industrial warehouse with high windows and dust motes dancing in blue-tinted light.
beats: Wide shot: the figure sits motionless on a wooden crate in the center of the floor
Medium shot: the figure reaches out to touch a cold steel pillar
Close-up: the figure stares blankly at a crack in the concrete floor
Medium shot: the figure slowly stands up and turns in a circle
Wide shot: the figure walks toward a distant, shadowed corner
scenes.video_prompt: Fine particles of dust drift through the blue light beams. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: The camera glides forward with extreme slowness toward the figure.

scenes.lead: Needle-felted wool diorama photographed in soft daylight:
scenes.style: Everything built from dyed carded wool fibers — fuzzy matted surfaces, visible needle-poke marks, loose fiber wisps catching the light, handmade craft object on a tabletop, shallow depth of field. No photorealism — the material and process are the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: A cramped studio filled with mounds of colorful wool and hanging textile scraps.
beats: Close-up: the figure's hands pull a thick strand of crimson yarn
Medium shot: the figure sits on a stool surrounded by fabric piles
Close-up: the figure's eyes watch a needle pierce through a heavy cloth
scenes.video_prompt: Soft fabric scraps sway slightly from an unseen vent. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: The camera pans slowly across the texture of the wool.

scenes.lead: Risograph print, two ink layers only (fluorescent pink and teal):
scenes.style: Visible halftone dot screens, slight misregistration between layers, ink smudge, matte uncoated paper grain, flat poster shapes. No photorealism — the material and process are the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: A bright white minimalist gallery with vibrant magenta and yellow geometric shapes on the walls.
beats: Wide shot: the figure walks briskly down a long, brightly lit corridor
Medium shot: the figure stops to examine a large colorful print on the wall
Medium shot: the figure turns and walks quickly toward a bright doorway
Close-up: the figure's feet stepping rapidly across a polished floor
Wide shot: the figure disappears into a brightly lit hallway
scenes.video_prompt: Bright, saturated light pulses rhythmically from the overhead fixtures. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.mid: The camera follows the figure at a steady walking pace from behind.

scenes.style: Leaded came dividing saturated colored glass, luminous jewel tones, glass texture and trapped bubbles, heavy dark lead lines, medieval craft. No photorealism — the material and process are the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: A dark stone chamber illuminated by intense, fractured beams of multi-colored light.

Medium shot: the figure spins wildly in a patch of deep red light
Close-up: the figure's face as it is struck by a beam of bright violet
Medium shot: the figure stumbles through a thick curtain of light
Wide shot: the figure sprints toward a massive luminous window
scenes.video_prompt: Vibrant colored light beams shift across the stone floor. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

scenes.lead: Layered cut-paper diorama in a shadow box:
scenes.style: Six stacked planes of hand-cut textured cardstock, visible paper edges and drop shadows between layers, matte colored stock, craft-object lighting. No photorealism — the material and process are the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: An outdoor courtyard filled with white paper-like trees and layered paper hedges.

Medium shot: the figure rests their head against a white textured trunk
Close-up: the figure's hands resting still in their lap
Wide shot: the figure remains seated as the light fades
